editorial:
Imagine a group of women in 1980s France who decide that the best way to rob banks is to simply pretend they are men. You get to follow this crew as they put on fake mustaches and deep voices to pull off a string of heists in the Avignon area. It is a wild ride that feels like a mix of a heist movie and a buddy comedy. The vibe is lighthearted and colorful, making you root for these ladies as they outsmart the local police and deal with the stress of keeping their secret identity hidden from everyone around them.

What really makes this work is the chemistry between the leads; they feel like real friends who just happen to be criminals. The pacing is quick, and the costumes are a lot of fun to look at. While some of the plot points are a bit predictable, the charm of the characters makes up for it. If you want a breezy movie for your weekend, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when the police finally close in on the gang. After a series of narrow escapes, the women realize they cannot keep the act going forever. They manage to secure their loot and vanish before the law can put them behind bars. The movie wraps up by showing how their bold plan actually worked, leaving you feeling happy that these daring women got away with it all in the end.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves heist movies with a funny twist.
